nasa_table.limits: NASA comparison table, metric units. Values are research-based snapshots and not a single canonical official constant set.

nasa_notes.limits: Definitions and provenance notes; detailed values may change with research.

mercury.limits: Mercury fact-sheet snapshot; magnetic-field values are model ranges.

venus.limits: Venus fact-sheet snapshot; atmospheric values are approximate where marked.

earth.limits: Earth fact-sheet snapshot; atmospheric composition and ranges are rounded.

mars.limits: Mars fact-sheet snapshot; excludes the caveated core-radius value from questions.

jupiter.limits: Jupiter gravity/radius values refer to the 1-bar level where stated.

saturn.limits: Saturn gravity/radius values refer to the 1-bar level where stated.

uranus.limits: Uranus gravity/radius values refer to the 1-bar level; magnetic coordinates are Voyager-model results.

neptune.limits: Neptune gravity/radius values refer to the 1-bar level; atmospheric values include published ranges.
